content: APP IN SNAP (Private) Limited is a software house based in Pakistan, established in 2015. It specializes in designing and developing hybrid applications, web applications, and digital commerce solutions. The company has 200+ employees and works with a multicultural team across various industries.

APP IN SNAP builds software solutions across multiple verticals including Fintech, Transportation, Healthcare, Retail, E-commerce, Logistics and warehouse management, Housing society ERP, and Legal & Law Enforcement organizations.

APP IN SNAP offers digital technology services, digital infrastructure services, and business process outsourcing (BPO). Their goal is to enhance business performance across digital channels by connecting networks and integrating large amounts of data.

APP IN SNAP provides Fintech expertise and technology proficiency to help businesses achieve resilience and growth. Their Fintech solutions offer secure and efficient financial transactions for both businesses and consumers, and they are recognized among top fintech app development companies.

APP IN SNAP helps healthcare organizations foster innovation and digital transformation. Their solutions facilitate data conversation between healthcare systems and stakeholders, enabling informed decision-making and personalized patient care.

APP IN SNAP offers custom e-commerce software development services with an outside-in approach to deliver diversified growth strategies. Their e-commerce platforms are designed to enhance user experience and drive sales.
APP IN SNAP leverages cutting-edge technologies to provide efficient warehouse, stock control, transportation, and fleet management operations for logistics businesses.
APP IN SNAP offers complete ERP solutions for housing societies to digitally manage clientage for residential, commercial, and business complexes.

APP IN SNAP develops fully customized ERP solutions built from the ground up to address unique business needs. These are mobile-responsive ERP systems giving flexibility to access critical business data and manage operations from any device, including disaster recovery and backup solutions.

Application Integration connects software applications and systems to work cohesively, sharing data and functionality seamlessly. APP IN SNAP offers custom application integration services ensuring intelligent and secure connections between diverse software applications.
Application Integration services include API Integration, Cloud Integration, Data Integration, Process Integration, mobile app integration, and Enterprise Application Integration (EAI) services.

APP IN SNAP has customized API integration services that maximize applications' working potential, facilitating seamless communication between different software systems and smooth flow of data across the digital ecosystem.

APP IN SNAP's Cloud Integration Automation Service maximizes the benefits of cloud computing by seamlessly integrating cloud-based applications, boosting scalability, accessibility, and overall system efficiency.
Point-to-point integration is a direct connection between two systems, enabling them to communicate and share data without an intermediary.
In addition to Application Integration, APP IN SNAP offers IT Consultancy, Software Development, System Integration, and Data Analytics services.

APP IN SNAP was awarded the Strategic Alliance Partner of the Year Award by Huawei in 2023, and was nominated for the Huawei Partner of the Year award in 2022, recognizing their work driving digital transformation.
APP IN SNAP is located near Chaklala Scheme III, Rawalpindi, Pakistan. Contact number: +92 51 8744255. Website: appinsnap.com.

AppInSnap's mission is to deliver 360-degree IT solutions that cater to the diverse needs of clients, enabling them to optimize operations, reduce costs, and stay ahead of the competition. The company has a team of more than 220 people and is committed to exceptional customer service, embracing the latest technology trends, and fostering a culture of innovation and continuous learning.

AppInSnap's Application Integration Services implement strategies and technologies to enable smooth communication and collaboration between different software applications within an organisation, such as connecting CRM systems with email marketing platforms to sync data. Their API integration services maximize applications' working potential and ensure smooth data flow across the digital ecosystem. Their data integration services consolidate, manage, and analyze data from diverse sources to break down data silos. Their Process Integration services optimize data flows and streamline business operations, reducing manual interventions.

AppInSnap's Enterprise Application Integration services connect disparate systems within a business, improving workflow processes, enhancing data visibility, and reforming communication channels. This includes ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) and CRM (Customer Relationship Management) software solutions designed to modernize business processes, increase collaboration, and support growth, along with application security and UI/UX design services for enterprise applications.

AppInSnap's ERP services for professional services businesses include: minor bug fixes and major software upgrades, integrating any ERP system with existing business software to improve data flow and productivity, developing custom ERP applications tailored to specific business needs, and expert ERP consulting to help businesses select and implement the right ERP system for their goals.

AppInSnap built the Smart Traffic Enforcement System, a smart, scalable digital e-challan (traffic violation ticketing) platform. It has been deployed and proven effective in Islamabad Capital Territory, Lahore Ring Road, and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province, and is designed to scale to other regions to enhance transparency, efficiency, and road safety.

The Smart Traffic Enforcement System includes: field enforcement via a dedicated mobile app for officers to issue violations on the spot, a secure web-based central management portal for backend operations, role-based access for authorized staff only, real-time challan (ticket) issuance with IMEI-based device authentication, zone-wise officer assignment, violation type selection with pre-defined penalties, license point management with auto-alerts and suspensions, digital document management for confiscation tracking, secure audit trails for legal and compliance purposes, and an administrative dashboard for system usage, revenue, and reporting.

AppInSnap offers end-to-end tailor-made software solutions with functions needed for Legal & Law Enforcement organizations to improve investigations. Their Smart Traffic Enforcement System is a concrete example of this, built for public safety and traffic law enforcement agencies with comprehensive technical training, ongoing support, and customization options.
APP IN SNAP has an estimated revenue in the range of $18.5 million and operates as a business services / custom software & IT services company.

AppInSnap builds solutions across a range of verticals including Fintech, Transportation, Healthcare, and Retail. Note: for Healthcare and general Retail/BPO, only high-level descriptions are publicly available (fostering digital transformation, custom e-commerce development, and business process outsourcing respectively) -- detailed feature breakdowns like the ones available for Application Integration, ERP, and Traffic Enforcement are not published for these areas.
